# Quality Gates & Delivery Fidelity Checklist: ArtCraft Local Authoring

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the visual quality gates — Tier A human review, Tier B automated delivery-fidelity (SSIM/PSNR), quality floors, budget compliance, atomic write recovery, and the Tier D fixture exclusion — ensuring the spec defines measurable, consistent, and complete quality requirements.

**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) — FR-007, FR-012, FR-013, SC-002, SC-007a, SC-007b, Constitution Principle IV, V

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `__SPECKIT_COMMAND_CHECKLIST__` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## Tier A — Human Visual Review Requirements

- [x] CHK001 — Is Tier A explicitly defined as a **human** review gate (stakeholder visual review)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK002 — Is the side-by-side documentation requirement explicitly specified per master (size, format, qualitative impression)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 — Is the palette/tonal-range verification explicitly required as part of Tier A review notes (documented human review, not a new automated gate)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 — Is self-review by the maintainer explicitly permitted (solo maintainer), with a second reviewer encouraged but not mandatory? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK005 — Is the `Reviewed-By` commit trailer explicitly required for any master-integration commit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK006 — Is the Tier A enforcement explicitly placed in the CI step (fail-closed), not in `npm run ci`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Tier B — Automated Delivery-Fidelity Gate

- [x] CHK007 — Is Tier B explicitly defined as an **automated, CI** gate? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK008 — Are the SSIM thresholds explicitly specified: ≥ 0.95 (standard) / ≥ 0.90 (light)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 — Is the PSNR floor explicitly specified: ≥ 30 dB (catastrophic failure floor, not a quality target)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK010 — Is the ffmpeg `ssim` filter explicitly chosen (with the explicit note that ffmpeg has no `ms_ssim` filter)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK011 — Is the ffmpeg `psnr` filter explicitly chosen? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK012 — Is the comparison reference explicitly specified: **lossless PNG of the master rendered at each delivery width** (not the native-size master)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK013 — Is the per-width comparison requirement explicitly stated (variant at width W compared to master re-scaled to W, because SSIM is scale-dependent)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK014 — Is fail-fast behavior explicitly specified for standard variants? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK015 — Is warn-only behavior explicitly specified for `-light-*` variants (degradation accepted by design)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK016 — Is the reporting requirement explicitly specified when byte budget forces quality down (report achieved SSIM/PSNR per frame, no silent degradation)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK017 — Is the Tier B gate placement explicitly specified: **after** `ensureImage()` for each generated variant in `build-images.mjs`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK018 — Is it explicitly stated that no new dependency is introduced (libvmaf, SSIMULACRA 2, LPIPS rejected)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]

## Tier D — Synthetic Fixture Exclusion

- [x] CHK019 — Is Tier D explicitly defined (synthetic fixtures get no perceptual gate)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK020 — Is it explicitly stated that synthetic fixtures receive only structural/byte/integrity checks? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK021 — Is Tier C (SSIMULACRA 2 / LPIPS) explicitly characterized as an offline maintainer aid, not a CI gate? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Quality Floors (Explicit, Non-Silent)

- [x] CHK022 — Are the standard quality floors explicitly specified: AVIF ≥ 30, WebP ≥ 45, JPEG ≥ 45? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK023 — Are the light quality floors explicitly specified: AVIF ≥ 20, WebP ≥ 30, JPEG ≥ 30? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK024 — Is the throw behavior explicitly specified (throw naming the frame) when quality floor is not met, rather than silent degradation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
  - **Resolved (2026-10-17, batch 9)**: both floors throw (FR-012, Assumptions, research §11); `data-model.md` corrected from "warn-only" to "`encodeImage` throw naming frame".
- [x] CHK025 — Are the quality floors consistent between FR-012 and the Assumptions section? [Consistency]

## Canvas & Geometry Requirements

- [x] CHK026 — Is the authoring canvas explicitly specified as **1200×800 px (3:2)**? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK027 — Is the rationale for 1200×800 explicitly documented (manifest geometry frozen, per-frame budget, no delivery benefit above largest delivered width)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK028 — Is the rejection behavior for masters > 1200 px explicitly specified as fail-fast with error code `invalid-master-geometry`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK029 — Is the ≤ 2560 px rigid ceiling explicitly preserved (unchanged from FR-002)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK030 — Is the no-upscaling requirement explicitly stated (`withoutEnlargement: true`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK031 — Are the three distinct limits clearly distinguished: 1200 px authoring target (rejected), 2560 px rigid ceiling (rejected), 300 000 B per-frame budget (enforced by build)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Budget Compliance (SC-002)

- [x] CHK032 — Is the per-frame budget explicitly defined as the **sum of largest AVIF + largest WebP + largest JPEG** (light variants excluded from per-frame but included in total)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK033 — Is the total assets budget explicitly specified as ≤ 30 000 000 bytes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK034 — Is the baseline headroom explicitly noted (~35–45 KB per frame) as a measured value? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK035 — Is the budget check explicitly placed in `build.mjs` (not in `build-images.mjs`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]

## Atomic Write & Recovery (FR-013)

- [x] CHK036 — Is atomic write explicitly required for all generated variants (image/audio + Tier B reference PNG)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK037 — Is the write-temp-then-rename pattern explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK038 — Is the same-directory requirement for temp files explicitly specified (same filesystem → atomic `rename()`, no `EXDEV`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK039 — Is the rationale for rejecting `os.tmpdir()` explicitly documented (tmpfs may be a different filesystem)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK040 — Is the scratch location explicitly specified as `build/` (git-ignored, never in `assets/`/`dist/`/`src/`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK041 — Is the rationale for rejecting `assets/` for Tier B reference explicitly documented (findUnreferencedAssets test runs before build:images)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK042 — Is the re-run safety explicitly specified (reexecuting `build:images` is always safe after interruption)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK043 — Is the `ensureImage` "failed validation and must not be overwritten" throw explicitly characterized as a safety net, not the expected recovery path? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## End State — All 4 Frames Authored (SC-001)

- [x] CHK044 — Is the requirement that **all 4 frames** (frame-01…frame-04) be authored explicitly stated? [Completeness, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK045 — Is the prohibition of publishing the mixed synthetic+authored state explicitly stated? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK046 — Is the constitutional basis for requiring all 4 frames explicitly cited (Principle V: coherent style, resolution, palette)? [Traceability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK047 — Is the full build command sequence explicitly specified as the validation (`npm run validate && npm run build:images && npm run build`) with exit 0? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Consistency & Coverage

- [x] CHK048 — Are the SSIM/PSNR thresholds consistent across FR-007, SC-007a, and the research/clarification batches? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK049 — Is the Tier A vs Tier B split consistently defined (human vs automated, sidecar vs ffmpeg)? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK050 — Are there quality scenarios not covered by the four tiers (A, B, C, D) that should be explicitly addressed? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK051 — Is the relationship between Tier A (subjective) and Tier B (objective) explicitly complementary rather than substitutive? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
